description: This file defines a Robolectric shadow class for android.graphics.Paint, specifically overriding the hasGlyph method to simulate glyph presence based on a static set, and providing methods to manipulate this set for testing purposes.

classes.name: MyShadowPaint
classes.description: A Robolectric shadow class for android.graphics.Paint that allows simulation of glyph presence for testing.

methods.name: hasGlyph
methods.description: Overrides the hasGlyph method to return false if the text is in the msTextsWithoutGlyphs set, true otherwise.

methods.name: addStringWithoutGlyph
methods.description: Adds a string to the set of texts that are considered to have no glyphs.

methods.name: clearGlyphs
methods.description: Clears the set of texts without glyphs, resetting the shadow's state.
